{
  "project_id": "P-ALB-CitizenServiceDelivery",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "ADISA and MIPA lack prior experience with World Bank fiduciary and procurement guidelines, creating a risk of procurement bottlenecks, evaluation delays, and non-compliance.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish a dedicated PMU in ADISA staffed with qualified procurement and financial management specialists, backed by intensive World Bank training and POM guidelines.",
      "evidence": "Neither MIPA, nor the recently constituted ADISA have previous experience in implementation of large donor funded operations... procurement risk rating is high."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "The reform program's highly compressed implementation timeline across dozens of agencies risks slippage in business process re-engineering and DLI achievement.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Sequence project interventions to secure early quick wins while utilizing results-based financing (DLIs) to incentivize key structural milestones through 2020.",
      "evidence": "The Government’s timeline for the reform is very ambitious... The compressed implementation timeline is a potential risk"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Institutional resistance and reluctance from line agency personnel and field staff to cede front-office service functions to ADISA could delay implementation.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deploy structured change management programs, stakeholder outreach, and strategic oversight through the Prime Minister-led Inter-Ministerial Public Services Committee.",
      "evidence": "Institutional reforms can be expected to be met with caution at the agency level, if not opposition... field level staff is likely to resist."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Over-focusing on centralized high-end citizen service centers and online e-services risks excluding poor, rural, elderly, and minority populations with low digital literacy.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide assisted internet access points, retain upgraded regional service counters, and execute targeted outreach campaigns using community and grassroots organizations.",
      "evidence": "There is a risk that the focus on state-of-the-art means for service delivery... will diminish access of the poor and vulnerable"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Construction of the new Citizen Service Center building in Tirana could generate localized environmental hazards including noise, dust, waste generation, and traffic congestion.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate the site-specific Environmental Management Plan (EMP) into construction contracts and enforce strict monitoring of construction practices and permits.",
      "evidence": "Potential environmental impacts that are associated with new construction include dust and noise, waste generation, material supply, use of machinery on site"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Inadequate internal controls and manual payroll systems across participating agencies create financial management risks regarding accurate tracking of Eligible Expenditure Programs.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Procure customized accounting software for the PMU, deploy experienced FM specialists, and require regular financial reporting and Supreme Audit Institution external audits.",
      "evidence": "The overall financial management risk is rated as Substantial... payroll systems remain by and large manual systems"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "The client's limited experience with Results-Based Financing (RBF) modalities and DLI verification protocols could result in disbursement delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide targeted technical assistance, establish clear verification protocols, and maintain continuous hands-on guidance from World Bank country office staff.",
      "evidence": "GoA has limited experience with results-based lending. As a result, the counterpart requires targeted support"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Legacy paper registers, missing National ID numbers, and poor data quality across key agencies could impede system interoperability and online automation.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide technical assistance for business process re-engineering, database optimization, software architecture, and integration with the Government Interoperability Platform via NAIS.",
      "evidence": "Property and pension records, for example, are only partially digitized... The National ID number is missing for most records"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Delays or political opposition in passing essential Omnibus legislation through Parliament could postpone the legal elimination of obsolete permits and process reforms.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct early legal inventory reviews and maintain strong political drive via the Strategic Planning Committee to ensure timely drafting and passage of legislative packages.",
      "evidence": "Reform of government services and repeal of licenses, permits, and approvals will be implemented through omnibus legislation, expected to be passed"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Unfunded recurring operational costs, software licensing, and ongoing maintenance for the new CSC and IT platforms could threaten post-project financial sustainability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate comprehensive medium-term budget planning into the approved Reform Policy Document and capture efficiency savings to offset recurring operational expenses.",
      "evidence": "Ongoing operating costs are expected to include licenses and system operation and maintenance... cost of such upgrades should also be appropriately factored in."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Low public awareness and modest national internet penetration (60%) could lead to low adoption rates of newly established e-services on the e-Albania portal.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Launch multi-channel public communications campaigns and offer alternative assisted digital channels at local government desks and internet facilities.",
      "evidence": "there will be a need for a physical presence... given modest levels of internet penetration at only 60 internet users per 100 people"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Inconsistent administrative data reporting and flawed processing time definitions by line agencies could distort M&E tracking and obscure service delays.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish standardized KPIs across key agencies, cross-validate administrative data using proactive citizen text-message feedback, and perform periodic independent user surveys.",
      "evidence": "The data submitted by the IPRO office on the other hand routinely records that almost all applications are processed within the required six days."
    }
  ]
}
